segments.name: Prepared foods
segments.description: Manufactures and markets fresh deli-prepared foods, including all-natural specialty prepared refrigerated foods, sold to supermarkets, club chains, mass-market retailers and food distributors.
segments.evidence: Our primary products include chicken, beef and turkey meatballs, meat loaf, sausage-related products, and pasta and rice entrees.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by supermarkets, club chains, mass-market retailers and food distributors for its prepared food products, net of customer incentives such as discounts, slotting fees, coupons and rebates.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are principally sold to supermarkets, club chains, mass-market retailers, and food distributors.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired substantially all of the assets of Crown I Enterprises, Inc., a manufacturer of value-added proteins and ready-to-heat meals.
changes.evidence: On September 2, 2025, Crown 1 Foods, Inc., a Nevada corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, acquired substantially all of the assets of Crown I Enterprises, Inc. for a cash payment of approximately $17.3 million (the "Crown 1 Business").

changes.text: In 2023, the company changed its name from MamaMancini's Holdings, Inc. to Mama's Creations, Inc.
changes.evidence: in 2023, the Company adopted its current name "Mama's Creations, Inc.," and our common stock began trading under the ticker symbol "MAMA."

changes.text: In 2023, the company acquired the remaining interest in Chef Inspirational Foods, LLC, having acquired a minority interest in 2022.
changes.evidence: One year later, the Company acquired the remainder of CIF, for $3.7 million, including approximately $1.0 million in cash at closing and a $2.7 million promissory note.
